purpose: Exact finite-data affine-plus-periodic model checks; no asymptotic classification
selection: Select the smallest period fitting all training observations exactly, using rational arithmetic; validate that fixed model without selecting another period after seeing validation outcomes.
validation_requirement: Every withheld observation must match exactly.
earlier_sizes: After validation, report the earliest exact suffix of the full saved size list for the same fixed coefficients; do not refit using earlier observations.
